enchantments.tooltip: +5 Enhancement Bonus: +5 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Keen: Passive: The base critical threat range of this weapon is doubled. This does not stack with Improved Critical feat. Vorpal Strikes by this weapon also bypass all Fortification.
Reverberating 4: This effect causes the edges of this weapon to pulse with sound, dealing 4d6 sonic damage on each hit.
Jolting 9: This effect causes the edges of this weapon to arc with electricity, dealing 9d6 Lightning damage on each critical hit.
Blunted Ammunition: The ammunition fired by this weapon deals blunt damage in addition to its other damage types.
Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
